_note: Qualifies the multi-node path (docs/multi-node.md). Submit with: slurm/submit.sh --site mysite --nodes 2 --time 00:20:00 examples/specs/nccl-2node.json. The same spec runs on every node, one launcher per node, one task per GPU; rank = SLURM_NODEID x 4 + local rank. NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME names the bootstrap interface (ib0 on JUPITER); NCCL then uses InfiniBand natively. Replace /path/to/ganymede.
